base.description: CRS317-1G-16S+RM - 16 SFP+ cages, one 10/100/1000 management port and the RJ45 console, with two built-in AC supplies and two fans. The box holds two IEC cords, rack ears and a K10 screw kit.

description: MikroTik CRS317-1G-16S+RM is a fixed 1U Cloud Router Switch with 16 SFP+ cages, one 10/100/1000 management port and an RJ45 serial console. It runs SwOS or RouterOS (dual boot). The front carries the 16 cages in four blocks of four. Each has an ACT lamp, a 10G lamp and its printed name, SFP+ 1 to SFP+ 16. Beside them sit the CONSOLE jack, the ETH/BOOT jack, the RESET button and the USR, FAULT, PWR 2 and PWR 1 lamps. The rear carries two IEC C14 inlets (POWER 1 and POWER 2), two fans and a finned heatsink. Two supplies are built into the chassis, one active at a time, so there are no bays. The left and right walls are not drawn.

name: crs317-1g-16s-plus-rm

built-in-power-and-fans.note: The product page lists two AC inputs, two PSU slots and two fans; the brochure says dual redundant power supplies; the quick guide says the device takes power through two IEC C14 connectors and only one supply is active at a time, the second being for redundancy. No document held shows a removable supply module or gives a supply part number, and the rear photograph shows two bare inlets and no module handle, so the supplies are built into the chassis and there are no bays, as on juniper/ex2300-24t. The two fans are the two hexagon-grille openings of the rear photograph. The quick guide says the passive heatsinks cool the unit and the two redundant fans switch on when the ambient is above normal.

buttons.note: One round button printed RESET (quick guide: the RouterBOOT reset button).

chassis.note: 443 x 44 x 224 from the brochure and the product page, which agree; no drawing is held to dimension them further. 443 is the body between the ear folds. The rear heatsink is part of the depth the sources print.

console.note: The RJ45 serial port (brochure: Serial port RJ45; quick guide: RJ45 serial port, 115200 bit/s) is the upper jack of the housing, under the printed CONSOLE. The lower jack is the ETH/BOOT management Ethernet port (quick guide: Ethernet port (ETH/BOOT), can be used for network booting).

datasheet.note: The brochure is MikroTik's datasheet for the model: product code CRS317-1G-16S+RM, CPU 98DX8216B0 800 MHz, two cores, 1 GB RAM, 16 MB flash, 16 SFP+ cages (1.25 Gb SFP and 10 Gb SFP+, none included), 443 x 224 x 44 mm, two AC inputs of 100 - 240 V, redundant supply, 44 W maximum power consumption, -20 to 60 C tested, 38 LEDs, serial RJ45. The 44 W is unqualified in the brochure and the product page, and the quick guide words it as the consumption under maximum load, so it is filed as the maximum. The quick guide says the device was tested from -40 to +70 C; the brochure and the product page say -20 to 60 C, which is carried (the quick guide's range is a conflict declared here). The product page's suggested price is not carried.

ears.note: Rack ears are in the box (product page, Included parts: Rack ears; the quick guide: 1U rackmount bracket, and the mounting section describes fitting them to both sides with four screws). Photograph 1324 shows them flush with the face. No drawing is held, so no distance behind the face is given. The product page also lists a K10 screw kit, which is a fastening set and not a rack kit, so no kit is listed. The ears are not drawn.

front-layout.note: estimated - read off photograph 1324 as described under gate-1. Four blocks of four SFP+ cages, the first cage at 13.2 mm, 14.25 mm apart inside a block and 63.5 mm block to block, top at 25.8 mm. Each cage has its ACT lamp 2.55 mm and its 10G lamp 12.2 mm from its left edge, 22.4 mm down, with the legends ACT and 10G above them, and the printed SFP+ n under the cage. The CONSOLE jack (top) and the ETH/BOOT jack (below it) share one housing 17.7 mm wide at 266.0 mm; the RESET button is at 287.6 mm. The USR, FAULT, PWR 2 and PWR 1 lamps sit in a rounded bracket at 295.3 mm on a 5.1 mm pitch. The slotted vent windows over the cages and the model text are drawn as the photograph shows them.

gate-1.note: estimated - the face of photograph 1324 is 3130 px wide between the ear folds for the printed 443 mm (7.065 px per mm) and 285 px tall for the printed 44 mm (6.48 px per mm), 0.92 of the horizontal scale, so the camera looks down and the photograph is not orthographic. Every x on the front is taken at 7.065 px per mm from the body's left edge; every y is taken at 6.48 px per mm from the face's top edge and is estimated, good to about 1 mm. The 4 x 14.25 mm SFP+ cages abut inside a block and read 100.7 px, 14.25 mm, on a quantity the scale never saw.

lamps.note: estimated - the brochure counts 38 LEDs: 16 cages x 2 lamps, the four status lamps and the two lamps of the ETH/BOOT jack. The status lamps are given the lit colours the photograph shows (USR yellow, FAULT red, PWR 2 and PWR 1 blue). Photograph 1324 shows the ACT and 10G lamps unlit. No held document says what a lamp shows; the quick guide has no LED table, so that is a gap.

port-numbering.note: The metal prints SFP+ 1 to SFP+ 16 left to right under the cages (photograph 1324), ETH/BOOT under the management jack and CONSOLE over the serial jack. The block diagram names the cages SFP+ 1 to 16 and the management port Ether 1.

rear-layout.note: estimated - read off photograph 2055, which looks down on the rear, so x is taken at 14.24 px per mm across the 443 mm width and y is estimated from a vertical scale of 12 px per mm, good to about 3 mm. The two C14 inlets are centred at 37.2 and 102.7 mm and carry POWER 1 and POWER 2 with 100-240V~2A MAX 50/60Hz printed under each. The two fan grilles are 36.5 mm across, centred at 160.8 and 200.1 mm. The heatsink fin ends fill 220 to 385.5 mm (22 fins drawn on a 7.1 mm pitch; the photograph shows about 23). Two of the rear's crosshead screws are drawn where the photograph shows them; the screws on the fan plates are not.
